title: Room and Choir
author: Oscar Pemberton
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
